name: Lifeist Wellness Inc.
summary: Lifeist Wellness Inc., headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, and established in 2005, is a wellness company operating in the United States and Canada that was formerly Namaste Technologies Inc. Its holdings include CannMart.com, an online store for hemp-derived CBD and accessories, Findify, an AI-powered personalised search and analytics platform for B2B e-commerce clients, and a facility that extracts butane hash oil.
